Text: Tensorflow - Multi-GPU doesn’t work for model(inputs) nor when computing the gradients. You can profile the behavior of the GPUs with nvidia-smi. I don't know if it is supposed to be like this, both the model(inputs) and tape.gradient to not have multi-GPU support. Specified a list of GPUs, for instance, strategy = tf.distribute.MirroredStrategy(['/gpu:0', '/gpu:1']). Added this strategy = tf.distribute.MirroredStrategy(cross_device_ops=tf.distribute.HierarchicalCopyAllReduce()) as @Kaveh suggested. How do I know that only one GPU is working?
